notes.subject: פרע
notes.rationale: 'Unbridled, loosened' (YLt/ASV) vs 'naked' (KJV, following a later sense of 'uncovered') vs 'out of control' (BSB).

notes.subject: פרוע/פרעה
notes.rationale: Root פרע repeated — the people's state is verb-for-verb what Aaron did; the echo is kept in Sepedi by repeating 'lokollotšwe'/'lokollotše'.

notes.subject: בקמיהם
notes.rationale: Literally 'among those who rise up against them', i.e. their enemies — rendered descriptively since Sepedi has no single word.

translation: Gomme Moshe a bona ⟨את⟩ setšhaba, gore se lokollotšwe, ka gobane Aharone o se lokollotše go ba tšhohoho go ba ba emeng kgahlanong le bona.
